name: admin_scope
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI scope: a credentialed view over a provider's resources, filtered by AWS, Kubernetes, and Git rules.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the scope. Immutable once created.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional description of the scope.

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: ID of the provider this scope is bound to. The provider resolves the credential and is required for the scope to access any resources (and, when mcp_server_id is set, its type must match the MCP server).

attributes.name: credential_name
attributes.description: Name of the credential (on the referenced provider) this scope uses. Either credential_name or mcp_server_id must be set.

attributes.name: mcp_server_id
attributes.description: ID of the MCP server backing this scope. Either credential_name or mcp_server_id must be set.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Whether the scope is active. Defaults to true.

attributes.name: metadata
attributes.description: Arbitrary key/value metadata attached to the scope.

attributes.name: aws_resource_search_filter
attributes.description: Optional filter restricting which AWS resources this scope can see.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: AWS region to scope resources to.

attributes.name: resource_types_regex
attributes.description: Regular expressions matching AWS resource types to include.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Tag key/value pairs resources must match.

attributes.name: key
attributes.description: Tag key.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Tag value.

attributes.name: kubernetes_filter_config
attributes.description: Optional filter restricting which Kubernetes resources this scope can see.

attributes.name: namespace_regex
attributes.description: Regular expressions matching namespaces to include.

attributes.name: namespaced_resource_types
attributes.description: Namespaced resource types to include (e.g. deployments, services).

attributes.name: cluster_resource_types
attributes.description: Cluster-scoped resource types to include (e.g. nodes, persistentvolumes).

attributes.name: git_resource_filter
attributes.description: Optional filter restricting which Git resources this scope can see.

attributes.name: repositories_regex
attributes.description: Regular expressions matching repositories to include.

attributes.name: branches_regex
attributes.description: Regular expressions matching branches to include.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the scope was created.

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the scope was last updated.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Server-incremented version of the scope.
